verdict.rationale: The only data-access path in the evidence is reading traces back: events can be queried in Timeline or through the SDK, and there is a semantic-search endpoint (POST /v1/search). A developer could script their own export from that, but the docs show no native bulk export and no blob-storage or warehouse destinations. The OpenTelemetry exporter mentioned only covers sending data into Chronicle, not out. Missing for 10: native bulk export of traces, dataset/task export, blob storage (S3/GCS/Azure) or data warehouse connectors, scheduled or streaming export, and any independent corroboration.
